description: Material list and cost for replacing a roof with IBR or corrugated steel sheeting in South Africa: number of sheets, screws and ridge capping, priced from current supplier prices that a person has checked and approved, with the supplier and price date on each line. Use estimate_works for an all-in installed rate instead.

area_m2.description: Roof surface area in m² (the sloped area, not the floor area)

include_labour.description: Add a labour rate per m² if one has been set

ridge_m.description: Optional ridge length in metres, to include ridge capping

name: roof_replacement_estimate
title: Roof replacement: materials from current supplier prices
